title: Montmartre Sun Face
description: A vibrant street scene of Montmartre in Paris features the Sacré-Cœur Basilica in the background. A large stylized blue line-art face with radiating sun rays emerges from a central white panel, overlooking pedestrians walking along a colorful cobblestone street lined with shops, awnings, and autumn trees.
prompt: A lively Parisian street in Montmartre with Sacré-Cœur Basilica visible in the background under a bright sun. In the center of the composition is a large white vertical panel featuring a stylized blue line drawing of a serene face with radiating sun rays. Colorful shops with red, orange, and green awnings line the cobblestone street where pedestrians walk. An autumn tree with yellow leaves stands on the right, flower pots and a blue umbrella on the left. Vibrant illustrative style with energetic brushwork.
